notes.title: Hotfix for December 3
notes.notes:
Text font bug is fixed.
Mission completed onboarding bug is fixed.
Text font wrong shader bug is fixed.
Pet interaction with non pet owners is fixed.
Farm level 2 collider bug is fixed.
Farming on level 3 is fixed.
Some mesh compression issue is fixed.
Old sedan locked in garage is displaced to front of garage.
Joe's tavern door bug is fixed.
Death loot indicator target maximum limit is increased.
A bug about Save System is fixed.(It may not be fixed the actual save bug. If you see a bug about saving please let us know from our Discord group.)

notes.title: Update Notes For November 11
notes.notes:
[olist]
 New npcs with side missions
 10 new npcs added. You can get side missions from them.
 56 different types of achievements are added.
 Faction System
 5 different faction is added. 
 Capital,Farmers,Mechanics,Mercenaries and Fishers.
 They have npc,market and missions.
 More faction mechanic will come later.
 New zones added. Night Club,Bank,Mansion,Embark Haul,Deathroot Marsh,Mine
 New car added.(Apex)
 New little zones added.
 Animal zone bug is fixed.
 Some ui bugs are fixed.
 Colliders bugs in different zones are fixed.
 Collectables bug is fixed.
[/olist]

Next update will be about bug fixing.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 14
notes.notes:
Garage customization bug is fixed.
Rain catcher water production is increased.
New vehicle is added.(Kaze)
New zones are added. (Kalasis Town,near the sea of desert).
Shop culling is fixed.
Kitchen level 3 navigation bug is fixed.
Bunker is activated.(Bunker level 2 and bunker level 3 will be added next update.)
Airdrop mechanic is activated.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 3
notes.notes:
Pet Mechanic
Pet mechanic added. Now,you can own a pet as a companion for yourself. 
It can help you in combat or looting. 
Only pet salesman is in Joe's Tavern now. 
In future will be more pet salesman.


New Zones
New zones to explored is added. 
There will be more zones will be added in this month. 


New Markets
New market npc's is added to open world, not only Joe's Tavern.
There are gun shop,butcher and seed shop for now. 
There will be more shops coming with next updates. 



Other
Light bug in the base is fixed.
Now foods also gives tiny health to player.

If there is something that you want to see in the game,you can jon our Discord channel.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 19
notes.notes:
Character Creator added. You can customize your character from main menu.
 Female character is added.
 Various skin colors,eye colors,hair types,beard types,eyebrow types added for both male and female.
While consuming a item on quick use slot doesn't disappear is fixed.
Rain Catcher's water produce amount is increased for all levels.
Player animation is freezing in start is fixed.
Requirements of dorm upgrade is changed.
First aid kit health value is increased.
New facility indicators are added.
Returning main menu and quitting the game waits for players approval before quitting.
Spawning multiple player death loots after loading the game fixed.
Saves not showing when loading game fixed.
New crafting particles added.
 CPU optimization is improved on AIs.
 Enemy counts on zones is balanced.
 Terrain texture bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for June 5
notes.notes:
-Issues with the farm fixed, now workers properly work (They plant available seeds from storage and gather grown plants)
-Attachment issues fixed.
-Entering exiting vehicles causing some issues on multiplayer fixed.
-Zombie step sounds playing on the base wrongly fixed.
-Death loots spawning with wrong loot fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 28
notes.notes:
Torch added to the game. (You can use it as a light source at nights)
 Level and skills save issue on multiplayer fixed.
 Garage Level 3 crafting table and vehicle customization fixed.
 Dropped items glitching through terrain fixed.
 When you get into an upside-down vehicle, it resets itself.
 The player now spawns in a proper position when exiting vehicles. (This fixes glitching through walls, terrain etc.)
 Crafting tables now saves craft queues.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 27
notes.notes:
-Issue with characaters arms when equipping a weapon fixed.
-Unequipped weapons not showing on the back of the character fixed.
-Garage level 2 Crafting table ui not showing fixed.
-Zombie loots rebalanced.
-Player death loot not spawning-not saving fixed.
-When assigning a worker, you can see the workers related skill to the job.
-Flashlight not closing when player is dead fixed.
-Vehicle towing is added. (You can tow vehicles with tow truck now.)
-Clothes giving wrong cloth when picking dropped clothes back fixed.
-Placing objects (Campfire,Chest) are fixed on multiplayer.
-Picking up placed objects giving multiple items fixed.

notes.title: Update Notes for May 24
notes.notes:
-Working speed of the workers on the base fixed.
-Garage Level 2 Crafts fixed.
-Required EXP to level up resetting to level 1 after reloading fixed.
-Crafting 12 Gauge ammo and Bow added to Armory.
-Stone plank craft recipe is fixed.
-Chinese missing font characters added.
-Resolution and fullscreen mode settings fixed.
-Environment volume setting added. (Affects weather effects)
-Inventory hotkey fixed.
-Not loading chosen language on settings fixed.
-Missing materials from "Garage" added.
